content.text: component of fungal cell membranes and alters permeability to allow leakage of ions and other intracell components → cell death
May be either fungistatic or fungicidal, depending on tissue concentration achieved and organism suscep
: broadest spectrum of coverage of all the antifungals
: infusion rxns (fever/chills, HA, malaise, rigors, BP chgs, thrombophlebitis, N/V), nephrotoxicity, ↓K & Mg, anemia, back/CP (AmBisome)
: empiric therapy of atypical fungal infections;
: transient visual disturb (photophobia, blurred vision, color chgs), hallucinations

: synthetic purine nucleoside analog w activity against HSV (types 1 and 2), varicella-zoster virus (VZV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV); stops replication of herpes viral DNA by competitive inhibition of viral DNA polymerase (selective toxicity), incorporation into and termination of the growing viral DNA chain, and inactivation of the viral DNA polymerase
: IV (inj site inflam or phlebitis, transient elevation of SCr/BUN, N/V), PO (GI disturb, HA, skin rash)
: triphosphate form inhibits viral DNA synth by competitively inhibiting viral DNA polymerases and by getting incorporated into viral DNA resulting in chain termination
: fever, abd pain, GI disturb, blood dyscrasias, rash, phlebitis/pain @ inj site

: closely resembles thymidine (also called trifluorothymidine); trifluridine = incorporated in place of thymidine into viral DNA, resulting in faulty DNA and the inability to reproduce or to infect or destroy tissue
: ophthalmic HSV, primary keratoconjunctivitis, recurr epithelial keratitis ← HSV1/2

roles.drugs: HSV: trifluridine or ganciclovir gel; oral valacyclovir or acyclovir if drops aren't feasible
Cycloplegic: atropine 1% or scopolamine 0.25% TID (your table: cyclopentolate)
